Secretary, Kasturba Health Society invites applications for the following posts with required qualifications:
Sister Tutor
– Must have M.Sc. Nursing with 2 years teaching experience in a recognized Institute. (2 posts – 1 ST, 1 SEBC)
Ward Sister
– Must have B.Sc. / M.Sc. Nursing with 5 years’ experience as Ward In charge in 500 bedded hospital (2 posts – 1 SEBC, 1 Open)
Laboratory Technician
– B.Sc. with DMLT from Govt. recognized Institute approved by State Technical Board / University with at least two years’ experience in a teaching institute. (5 Posts – 1 ST, 1 VJNT, 2 SEBC, 1 EWS)
Staff Nurse
– Must have passed Diploma in General Nursing & Midwifery/ B.Sc.Nursing, MSCIT and should be registered with Maharashtra Nursing Council, Mumbai with experience of working in a 500 or more bedded hospital.(2 Posts – 1 SEBC, 1 Open)
Dialysis Technician
– Must have graduation from recognized university or equivalent Diploma in Dialysis Technology 2 years experience in reputed hemodialysis center. (1 Post Open)
Refractionist
– Must have Diploma in Refractometry from recognized Institute/University with 2 years’ experience 500 bedded hospital / recognized Institute.
Clerk
– Must have Graduation from a recognized University, proficiency in operating computers, Typing 40 WPM English, Typing 30 WPM Marathi/Hindi and MSCIT with one year experience. (4 Posts – 1 ST, 1 SEBC, 1 EWS, 1 Open)
Driver
– Must have SSC/HSSC, Heavy /Light Transport license with 2 years experience. (1 post ST)
Attendant
– SSC of State/Central Board with two years experience in a 500 bedded hospital/Institute. (46 Posts – 5 NT, 3 SBC, 11 SEBC, 10 EWS, Open 17)
Candidates must have registration of Employment Exchange failing which application will not be considered.
Instructions:
The aspiring candidates should download the prescribed form of application from the official website i.e.
www.mgims.ac.in
and has to submit his/her application with the
Office of the Dean,
Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, P.O.Sevagram, Wardha 442102 latest by 4 PM of
3rd August 2019
along with the certified copies of certificates, documents, as required by the notification in this respect, appearing on the website. The application so received shall be screened by the Institute and shortlisted candidates shall be intimated about the date, time and place on which he/she is required to appear for skill test and interview (at their own cost).
Initially appointment will be for 2 years on consolidated salary and only after satisfactory completion of the said period they may be considered for regularization of service failing which services will be discontinued.
The age limit applicable for all posts shall not be below 18 years and not exceeding 38 years (for open)/ 43 years (for reserved category) years as on 31
st
July 2019.
Age and qualification can be relaxed for those candidates having experience in recognized medical teaching organization and possessing additional qualification for the designated job.
The Institute reserves the right related to selection or appointment and hence no right, claim should be assumed to have vested with the Applicant in this respect.
